subject: Nebula Analytics DPA — execution logistics and signatory confirmation
body:
From: Emma Rudd <emma.rudd@nebulaanalytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@nebulaanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: DPA redlines + execution path

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the DPA redlines. Attached is our annotated set (DPA_Redlines_v3.pdf) — our counsel highlighted two items we need clarity on before signature:

- EU data transfer language (standard contractual clauses vs. reliance on adequacy) — counsel prefers SCCs with explicit subprocessor notice windows.
- Countersign order: our board wants Nebula to sign first, then Redwood to countersign, and we need a clear timeline for Redwood countersignature after we complete execution.

Tom (cc'd) will be the signatory on our side; I'll attach his POA if you need it. Can you confirm whether Redwood can send the DocuSign envelope (so we sign first) or whether you need us to initiate from our account? Also—do you have a recommended template for routing (primary signatory -> legal witness -> countersign)?

Attachments: DPA_Redlines_v3.pdf; Nebula_POA_TomNguyen.pdf

Appreciate a quick note on routing and any required signatory authority checks.

Best,
Emma
Legal Ops | Nebula Analytics

-----
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Rudd <emma.rudd@nebulaanalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + execution path

Emma — thanks for the note and the attachments. Confirming receipt. High-level answers up front:

- We can support Nebula signing first with a Redwood countersign. DocuSign supports that flow (sequential signing order).
- We will verify Tom's POA against our checklist (POA scan, government ID, corporate board minutes if required).
- For EU transfers: our standard approach is SCCs + a subprocessor notice clause; we can accept the specific SCC language your counsel proposes but will need a short internal review (we typically complete that within 48 hours for small edits).

Operational ask from our side: can you confirm Tom's full title and the signatory line you require (e.g., "Tom Nguyen, CTO, Nebula Analytics")? Also, please confirm whether you need a witness or not — some jurisdictions want a witness for executive signings.

I'll loop in Monica (operations) and Karthik (privacy/legal) to coordinate the DocuSign envelope template and authority checks. Proposed next steps:

1) You confirm signatory details and return the POA as a flattened PDF.
2) Monica and I set up the DocuSign envelope with sequential routing: Nebula signatories -> legal witness (if needed) -> Redwood countersign.
3) We run a status check cadence (initial email, 48-hour reminder, final notice at 7 days).

I'll attach an annotated checklist for the routing we use.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redlines_annotated.md

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Rudd <emma.rudd@nebulaanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 08:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + execution path

Hi all — operational notes and template config below.

DocuSign template and routing we recommend (sequential):
- Recipient 1: Nebula Primary Signatory (email provided by Nebula) — routing order 1
- Recipient 2: Nebula Legal (optional witness/acknowledgement) — routing order 2 (if Nebula requires witness)
- Recipient 3: Redwood Countersigner (redwood-exec@redwoodinference.com) — routing order 3

Practical items for us to complete before sending envelope:
- Confirm signatory name + title + business address (for signature block).
- Confirm whether Nebula wants to use their DocuSign account (recommended) or have Redwood send (Redwood will act as envelope originator by default). If Nebula initiates, make sure envelope is configured for sequential signing and that Redwood is set as final signer.
- POA verification: acceptable forms are notarized POA or certified board resolution + govt ID. If you only have the POA PDF, upload it to the DocuSign envelope as "supporting document" and we will request a notarized copy if our IP team flags it.
- Reminder cadence: DocuSign automated reminders at 48 hrs and 5 days; Monica to monitor and escalate at day 7 if not signed.

Notes on countersign (Redwood internal):
- Countersign must be completed by an authorized Redwood officer (VP+ or delegated signatory). Karthik, please confirm delegate.
- If substantive redlines remain at execution, we prefer to capture agreed list in the envelope (attached errata) to avoid reexecution loops.

Link to our shared checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-nebula-dpa
DocuSign envelope template id (internal): TEMPLATE-REX-09

Monica
Contracts Ops | Redwood Inference

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Emma Rudd <emma.rudd@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2029 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + execution path

Thanks everyone. A couple legal clarifications from our side:

- On SCCs: we can accept SCCs as proposed but need the subprocessor notification window set to 30 days (our standard is 30 days notice for new subprocessors). Please have your counsel confirm.
- Authority validation: if Tom is signing as CTO, we need either a board resolution or the POA that explicitly authorizes the CTO to execute DPAs. The POA you shared looks like it grants operational authority — can you confirm the grant covers data processing agreements?
- Countersign timing: if Nebula signs first, Redwood requires up to 3 business days to complete countersign review and execution. We commit to completing countersign within that window unless substantive changes are flagged.

Operational request: please place "Redwood countersign within 3 business days" in a short execution note inside the DocuSign envelope (we'll use the signer's notes field) so both parties have an expectation.

If Nebula prefers AdobeSign instead, we can mirror the same sequential workflow but need the final signed PDF and audit trail sent to contracts@redwoodinference.com. DocuSign is preferred due to our automated status checks.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded Message-----
From: Emma Rudd <emma.rudd@nebulaanalytics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@nebulaanalytics.com, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2029 09:01:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + execution path

Markus / Monica / Karthik — quick confirmation from our side:

- Tom Nguyen will sign as: "Tom Nguyen, CTO, Nebula Analytics". We are attaching a notarized POA and completed board resolution page (Nebula_POA_TomNguyen.pdf).
- Nebula prefers to originate the envelope from our DocuSign account so we sign first; envelope id will be provided after we create it (we will share the URL).
- Nebula accepts the 30-day subprocessor notice window; counsel confirmed SCC insertion is acceptable.
- Countersign timing is noted — we expect Redwood to countersign within 3 business days.

DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/status/ENVELOPE-12345
Please confirm you will:
1) Add execution note in the envelope: "Redwood countersign within 3 business days"
2) Monitor and notify via contracts@redwoodinference.com when envelope status changes to "Completed"

If those two items are confirmed, we'll prepare and send the envelope by EOD today.

Thanks,
Emma
Legal Ops | Nebula Analytics

Attachments: Nebula_POA_TomNguyen.pdf

--End of thread--
